title: [SLS][29.x] Backport production app updates for GPT-5.6 Ceres
summary: Backports the Sales Lines Suggestions production changes from main to 29.x: both AI call paths now use GPT-5.6 Ceres, six prompts ship inside the app, missing quantities default to one, and search confidence thresholds are lowered to match the new embedding model.
key_points: Backport of main's Sales Lines Suggestions app changes to releases/29.x, with no tests included
GPT-5.6 Ceres is selected for both production AI call paths
Six task, tool and CSV prompts are packaged as app resources; the safety prompts stay in Key Vault
Unsupported mixed requests fall back for the whole message; missing quantities default to one, while explicit zero and fractions are kept
Search thresholds are aligned to the new embedding model (minimum 0.25; High 0.55, Medium 0.45, Low 0.25)
quote: Select GPT-5.6 Ceres for both production AI call paths.
